topicName: How do you perform string manipulation in PL/SQL (e.g., concatenation, substring extraction)?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"How do you perform string manipulation in PL/SQL (e.g., concatenation, substring extraction)?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"String manipulation in PL/SQL involves using built-in functions to modify and extract portions of character strings. Common operations include concatenation (joining strings), substring extraction (getting parts of a string), finding the length of a string, and replacing parts of a string."}]
